background: Nottingham Building Society is a regional mutual in the East Midlands, funded by retail savings from its branches and lending on residential mortgages, including to self-employed and less standard borrowers.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the society. Capital is the weak side against UK building societies: CET1 of 14.3% and leverage of 5.1% are both in the bottom quarter, against the peer medians. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 257% in the top quarter and up 88 points since 30 Jun 2024, while NSFR of 142% is in the bottom quarter against 145%. The other ratios have been flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A society that has built a large short-term liquidity cushion while running less capital than most of its peers.
